verdict.rationale: Hightouch does handle data in bulk: syncs push whole model result sets to destinations, CDC sends only new, changed and removed rows, and the HTTP Tracking API has a batch endpoint that accepts multiple events in one request. Git Sync and the REST API let users manage workspace resources programmatically, which implies scripted multi-resource changes, but no explicit bulk action across many syncs or audiences is documented. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on many workspace resources at once (e.g., bulk-editing, pausing or triggering multiple syncs or audiences), evidence that the MCP server or agent can run multi-item operations in one request, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
